title: 成大全壘打

caption: energetic stadium cheer jingle, marching band brass fanfare, big punchy drums, hand claps, crowd chants and gang vocals, call-and-response, male lead shouting with crowd answers, celebratory home run moment, bright triumphant major key, polished sports anthem production
